name: keeps-what-it-was-written-with
about: Designed on 2026-11-23 and worked by hand before any code (ENGINE.md section 20; D75). Write stays on throughout, so no view here depends on what the grid shows with write off. Stopped: slider A goes to 10000 and key 1 puts sound 1 on step 1, which keeps A 10000 and B 32768. A goes to 50000 and key 5 puts sound 1 on step 5, which keeps A 50000 and B 32768. Then B goes to 20000: no step is written after that, so no step keeps it. A key in write mode makes no sound, so nothing has fired and the second mark (ea, eb) shows the sound's own values, which are the hand's. Play starts at run step 4. Step 1 fires with what it kept: the cap says 50000 and 20000 and the mark says 10000 and 32768. Four steps later step 5 fires: the mark moves to 50000 and stays at B 32768. The trace is two hits; the keeping is in the views.
